_comment: Dialog lines, English (the fallback for every other language). Translations live in lang/<code>/dialogs.json with the same structure; a missing key or line falls back to this file. {size}/{cost} are filled by the code; {shake:..} is dialogue markup; {sfx:purse} at the start of a line brings the purse up.

landlord._comment: The landlord's phone call. Lists are said line by line. first_call plays once per save file (no offer); greetings picks one line at random; tiers.<n> is the offer for room tier n (2 = 6x6, 3 = 7x7, 4 = 8x8, more = every 10k tier): pitch, then broke (not enough coins, no choice) or the Yes/No choice on the last pitch line, then accepted. refuse_first/second after a No (the count resets on entering the room); refused_out replaces the call after two refusals; maxed when no bigger tier exists. {sfx:purse} at the start of a line brings the purse up (the caller's onSfx handles it).
landlord.name: Landlord
first_call: So you are the new tenant...
I hope you are not too noisy, you know, it is not very good for business...
The room is too small you say? Hmmm...
Call me back, and be sure to bring shiny doubloons with you.
If you can pay a generous extra, I might consider it.
Now get out, time is money, and this call is keeping me broke.
greetings: Oh, it is you. Let's see what we are on today.
Calling me for a room extension? Let me check how rich you will make me today.
Here for a deal? Time for real business.
I can smell... the fragrance of fresh bank notes.
You want a bigger room? I want a bigger purse! Let's talk.

pitch: {sfx:purse}Let's start simple. For a hundred of your shinies, I can give you a first decent expansion to your house.
I am being very generous, you know, it is a bit narrow in here, isn't it?...
So what do you think? Deal?
accepted: Excellent, enjoy your bigger room, while I enjoy my bigger pockets...
How did I manage to expand it like this? You would stop paying if I revealed my secrets.
Call me back if it still feels too small...

pitch: So the current room is too small for you?
{sfx:purse}I got you. But this time the price will be a grand, for grand ambitions!
Enough talk, time to let the flooz decide!
broke: That's unfortunate, but eagles do not fly with pigeons!
accepted: How did I find the space to extend your room, you say?
I just expelled your neighbour, he was noisy anyway! Haha
At least you will sleep better from now on too, right?

pitch: Sounds like it is never enough for you...
{sfx:purse}5 grand. Take it or leave it.
broke: Of course a kid like you does not have this kind of money.
You gotta work more for OpenBurgers, son!
accepted: Wait, you actually paid for it?
Not that it bothers me, but you know...
If you keep being gullible like this I might start to feel guilty about it!
Whatever, you do not seem to care anyway! Here comes the moola!

pitch: {sfx:purse}10 grand. On my OpenBank, as usual.

landlord.maxed: Sorry, there is no bigger expansion available.
landlord.refuse_first: That's unfortunate. Feel free to call me back if you reconsider.
refused_out: ... No, do not waste my time.

pod.locked: You press the panel on the Mysterious pod. It hums, but nothing opens. Not yet.

phone.enum_wait: The line crackles for a moment. "Terribly sorry, dear. The music catalogue is still being sorted, and visits are such a mess without it. Do call back once every record is on its shelf."
